description: Public timelapse clearance and parking geometry contracts.

mutants.description: The same Y=14 point is blocked at 6 mm configured clearance and clear at 2 mm; ignoring expansion makes the blocked assertion fail.
The positive control above the expanded obstacle must remain clear; omitting the upper-Y rejection incorrectly blocks X0.
A 2 mm object at current print_z 1 mm exactly meets the 1 mm rod threshold; the inclusive comparison must add it and force the no-corridor fallback.
The second extruder has only the narrow x=[170,185] mm strip; the selected parking point must remain within those configured bounds.
